capabilities: Log workouts with sets, weight, reps, RPE and heart rate
Run rest timers with countdown and notifications
Analyze workout progress with the Claude API
Generate Markdown workout files with frontmatter properties for Dataview queries
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. AI analysis requires a paid Anthropic API key (starts with sk-ant-...).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record workouts, track sets and volume, or get training analysis from logged data.

relations.evidence: Claude API integration for intelligent workout analysis

summary: Workout tracker that logs exercises, sets and volume to Markdown notes, and uses the Claude API to analyze progress and recommend training.
